title: AuditMaintenanceResult
description: Result of `deadlatch audit verify` or `deadlatch audit repair --quarantine`. CLI JSON stdout must match this document. Issues list at most 100 entries (line_number + reason_code only). Never includes raw log lines, credentials, account data, or absolute paths. Repair success additionally reports quarantine_name (basename only), quarantine_sha256, and source_sha256.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this result document.

operation.description: Which audit-maintenance command produced this result.

status.description: clean = no invalid lines (verify or repair no-op); invalid = verify found damage; repaired = quarantine wrote at least one line; error = path/lock/IO failure.

valid_lines.description: Count of schema-valid audit records in the scanned snapshot.

invalid_lines.description: Count of damaged lines (UTF-8 / JSON / Schema / evaluated_at).

issues.description: Prefix of discovered problems, at most 100. Blank lines are not issues.

issues_truncated.description: true when invalid_lines exceeds the 100-issue echo cap.

quarantine_name.description: Basename of the unique quarantine JSON file. Present only when repair isolated at least one line.

quarantine_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the quarantine file bytes. Present only on successful repair.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the main audit file bytes before repair. Present on successful repair; optional on verify.
